title: STNFS v9: box norm bounds, lazy staged descent, five-vector Krylov passes: 119.9539

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md, DESCENT.md and STORAGE.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (Q=[a]Q0 from two GT logarithms; z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.3902 (hence at least 0.39) over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^119.9539 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^119.9538270. Collection: v5's region (excess 1.1, theta=2330/8000, retained relations >= 2^63.6617), certified norm bounds shared by 4x2x2 boxes of rows (v9), allowance 1.0171: <= 2^119.6768. Linear algebra: merge to weight 300 (N(300)/N(100) charged 0.711), N = 2^58.9429, eight owners, Block Wiedemann (28, 5) with 128-bit X entries, five-vector Krylov passes (krylov5.s; block selection and sign once per entry; 12.3 per vector-entry): <= 2^117.2564; generator <= 2^107.8065. Descent: v5's 62-node plan and boot (215, 344, 14, 4), UDUP 0.65, with lazy random-order cofactorisation, one-relation-at-a-time boot (at most 18) and staged sieving from radius 192 (stage reach probabilities from the NB law at the previous radius); failure events are v5's. Expected two-log work <= 2^113.6054; meter 2^114.333; Markov abort <= 0.6039078; boot failure 1.573e-03 per log, expected nodes 2^18.24, node abort 2^-9.06, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. All work is included; nothing amortized; memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, nonzero lower/upper integration controls, and the lazy-cofactorisation bound against a simulation. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-300 LA with five-vector Krylov kernels, eight-owner row tail), retention, ECM, lazy descent (with a simulation of the lazy process) and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
